name: get_current_view_elements
author: hprebar
title: Get elements in the current view
description: Elements visible in the active view, filtered by model and/or annotation categories (BuiltInCategory names such as OST_Walls, OST_Doors, OST_Dimensions). Without filters a default set of common model + annotation categories is used. Locations and lengths are reported in millimetres.

includeHidden.description: Include elements hidden in the view

limit.description: Maximum elements to return (0 = no limit)
